_comment: Edit 'watchlist' any time to change your own core tracked tickers, deep-dived every run. The old 'screener_universe' list is retired as of 2026-08-27 -- both the day-trade and investing screens now pull a large, dynamic candidate pool straight from FMP's screener every cycle instead of a fixed hand-picked list (see scripts/refresh.py), so they stop converging on the same familiar names. Nothing to edit for that anymore.
